name: Scorching Greater Magma · Lightning
primary:
A widening stream (up to 3 blocks wide) hits everyone in front of you; in instant mode it keeps going while held:
• Damage 6.25 ❤ fire + 2.25 ❤ earth + 3 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 32.4 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 8 blocks within 0.72 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Charge 70: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 6.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 32.4 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 10.5 s
• Slowness I for 8.25 s
• Charge 20: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
